claim: One DMU Form runs unchanged through four ports: in-process fixture, owned chat over HTTP, owned chat in Chromium, local ONNX model.
scope: owned fixtures and one small local model; no third-party service

claim: Invalid outputs, timeouts, refusals and partial streams are never recorded as completed DMUs.
Any single-field change to a Mark, or to its stored input/output, is detected.
scope: SHA-256 digests; 300 random trials + 12 targeted tampers

claim: A Pass transfers data and citations but no seat, credential, quota or authority.
Several views of one account never receive more calls than the account allowance.
Opening N views of one account multiplies permitted calls by N.
The per-lane capacity bound sum_i min(Q_i/T, r_i, c_i/L_i) from the brief is a valid upper bound when lanes share an allowance.
replacement: grouped bound sum_g min(Q_g/T_g, sum_{i in g} min(r_i, c_i/L_i))

claim: Local CPU-bound DMU throughput scales with lanes until the core count, then saturates.
scope: 4 cores; one run per point; 3.1x at 4 lanes, 3.2x at 8

claim: After SIGKILL mid-Turn, side-effect-free work resumes exactly once and work with unknown side effects is not re-sent.
The PURL/0.1 adapter is interoperable with the reference server for discovery, create, checkpoint export, idempotent replay, version conflict, safe GET and non-disclosure.
scope: subset listed in docs/INTEROPERABILITY.md; not full PURL conformance

claim: The ACSP/0.1 adapter is interoperable with the reference server for discovery, create, TOK append, checkpoint, idempotent replay, stale version, capability enforcement and safe prepare.
AWRM fully implements SEURL.
note: no executable SEURL specification exists; 3 of 7 verbs mapped to proposals

claim: Consumer ChatGPT, claude.ai or Gemini web UIs may be automated by AWRM.
AWRM provides unlimited or free model access.
Generated Seeds can propose and measure local improvements without gaining authority or network access.
scope: fixed procedure registry; in-process network tripwire

claim: Requiring whole-response integers reduces accepted wrong answers on math.check.
flan-t5-small answers 17 x 23 correctly.
note: rejected by the Form as invalid-output

claim: The kernel builds, tests and runs DMUs with no browser, no model package, no provider credentials and no legacy repository present.
All 14 experiments reproduce their verdicts and deterministic digests across two fresh runs.
Official Anthropic and Gemini API ports work against the live services.
note: wire format verified against an owned fake server only; no keys, no owner consent recorded
